sources.label: OpenAI Codex releases
sources.applied_takeaway: Codex 0.137.0 reinforces TUI controls, cloud-managed config, app-server remote-control grants, plugin JSON output, hosted web/image tools, and Windows sandbox setup refresh reliability.

sources.label: Model Context Protocol security best practices
sources.applied_takeaway: MCP-style connector and tool surfaces should be least-privilege, scoped, auditable, and protected against token leakage and confused-deputy behavior.

sources.label: OWASP Logging Cheat Sheet
sources.applied_takeaway: Status receipts should sanitize event data, avoid secrets and private paths, and prevent raw transport or sensitive debug material from entering durable logs.

sources.label: NVIDIA DGX Platform
sources.applied_takeaway: The AI-factory pattern maps cleanly onto GHC local/cloud orchestration: layered compute, repeatable workflows, measurable readiness, and infrastructure-aware scaling.

sources.label: NVIDIA DGX Spark system overview
sources.applied_takeaway: Desktop-scale AI systems benefit from explicit system overview, resource reporting, local prototyping boundaries, and transition paths to larger infrastructure.

x2_design_implications: treat app-server callable lanes as scoped remote-control surfaces
preserve redaction of app thread IDs and local temp paths
prefer machine-readable plugin and lane status outputs where available
separate local prototyping, live repair, and durable publication layers
